ABOUT THE ATLAS

Nine to Como

1 · The journey

Fictional sample with nine invented travelers, three route groups and a shared Como meetup. Dates are illustrative. All lines are provisional endpoint guides, not reviewed routes. The video is MDN’s flower playback test, not footage from Como. The photographs are existing illustrative atlas sample artwork.

2 · Every leg matters

Travel legs appear in their planned or recorded order. Open any day to isolate its route.

3 · Plans can grow

Days can start with a few notes. Destinations, routes, and photographs can be added as the journey takes shape.

4 · Photos follow the day

The full-screen viewer keeps each day's photographs together. Day controls move the route map and journal context with the images.

Privacy: the public site asks search engines not to index or archive it, but anyone with the URL can still open it.
